messages:
Tess: quick thread to finalize telemetry consent UX + onboarding playbook for the next DP wave.
Ibrahim: main constraints: clear choices, minimum friction, and legal-compliant retention. propose three options: none, telemetry (aggregated), traces (sampled prompts).
Claire: UX note: put short inline explanations and a "learn more" link that expands details. show retention days and whether prompts are stored. keep default to telemetry=none for enterprise unless they opt in.
Diego: backend needs: telemetry_level, consent_ts, consent_version, and opt_out_url recorded in account metadata. webhook example: {"account_id":"AC123","telemetry":"traces","consent_ts":"<ts>"}
Tess: Diego can you make the webhook spec and PR? Also include a webhook event for revoke: {"account_id":"AC123","revoke_ts":"<ts>"}.
Diego: yes. PR incoming. will include sample payload and error responses. also need a small audit log entry in infra.
Ibrahim: Legal: confirm we can accept "traces" if we encrypt at rest and have 30-day retention and delete on request within 30 days.
Legal: yes, we can. we want explicit language in the modal: "Sampled traces are encrypted and retained for 30 days; you can request deletion anytime."
Claire: outreach copy suggestion: "Help us test a private beta — choose what telemetry you're comfortable sharing. No prompts logged unless you opt into 'traces'."
Tess: rollout plan: 1) send invites -> 2) accept with telemetry choice -> 3) provision (canary 20m) -> 4) enable telemetry if chosen. if canary shows >2% errors or latency x2 then rollback telemetry ingestion for that account.
Diego: add a metric: telemetry ingestion error rate and telemetry processing latency. create alert if processing lags >5m for more than 10mins.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: "dp-telemetry-processing-lag" threshold 5m. Notifying #eng-oncall.
Ibrahim: evaluation hooks: each DP provides 15 representative prompts; we run baseline vs candidate and flag regressions. consent modal should ask permission to use prompts for evaluation (separate checkbox).
Legal: separate checkbox is good. include checkbox text in addendum. retention for eval artifacts is 30d.
Tess: acceptance gates: 1) at least 3 partners onboarded for 48h with telemetry as chosen, 2) P50 latency within SLA, errors <1%, 3) eval regressions <5% and at least two partner-provided prompts covered.
Claire: automation: on accept create GH issue with checklist, and add label telemetry={level}. I can add GH action to do that.
Diego: will add opt-out API: POST /accounts/{id}/telemetry/revoke -> returns 202 and enqueues deletion job.
Tess: timeline: copy & addendum by Wed, webhook PR by Thur, deployment + alerts by Fri, outreach next Monday. owners: Claire (UX + GH action), Diego (webhook + APIs), Ibrahim (legal sync), Legal (addendum).
Ibrahim: will review modal copy today and loop in privacy.
Tess: perfect. if blockers appear ping @here. :white_check_mark:
